''Resistance to Current Avatar's Element +20''
*The Summoner gains +20 [[Resistance|elemental resistance]] according to what avatar he/she has out, having [[Carbuncle]] summoned would grant +20 to light resistance to the summoner, while having [[Ramuh]] summoned would grant the summoner +20 thunder resistance.
*This is currently bugged, as it does not work for Diabolos. {{verification}}
